Establishment of 3 Working Groups (WG) to monitoring the technical implementation of project activities. • The project has conducted three workshops, and several independent meetings to ensure increased stakeholder involvement. • Ministers Decree 204, increasing entrance fees for Red Sea and South Sinai PAs. • Nature Conservation Sector (NCS) declared, in cooperation with the Chamber of Diving and Water Sports (CDWS), a policy mainly concerned with prohibiting intro-dives from boats because they often result in increased environmental infractions. • Implemented Policies: • Ministers Decree 204, increasing entrance fees for Red Sea and South Sinai PAs Nature Conservation Sector (NCS) declared, in cooperation with the Chamber of Diving and Water Sports (CDWS), a policy mainly concerned with prohibiting intro-dives from boats because they often result in increased environmental infractions. Declared by the CDWS in cooperation with NCS, a policy prohibiting any diving and snorkeling trips from land, unless a certified CDWS diver is accompanying the tour within PAs. Operationalisation of the Red Sea SEA has ensured the revision of existing policy frameworks.Reviewing Guidelines for the Tourism Development Authority (TDA) in order to identify areas where mainstreaming biodiversity can be enhanced and piloted.
• The project, through its WGs is supporting the incorporation of environmental measures in the hospitality criteria (HS) system.
• Continued implementation and introduction of voluntary sustainability mechanisms, such as Green Fins.

National Strategy to ban single use of plastic bag prepared. SESA for SIWA launched. Green Hotel Guidelines completed. Ecolodge guidelines completed. Number of Green Finns certificates increases to 34 for different diving centers.

The National Strategy for Banning single use plastic completed and a pilot was implemented in South Sinai to ban the use of single use of plastic bags. SESA for Siwa lounged and will be completed in 2023. Green Finns certificate increase to 36 diving centers. Guidelines for green star hotels and ecolodges were completed and lounged. A portal is also available for monitoring by the Ministry of Tourism.

Lounging and managing Eco Egypt campaign , Marine conservation campaign completed, preparation and accretion of the diving centers in sharm and red sea.. Technical assistance for the application and management of environmental measures in hotels. complete a business modeling strategy for the 30 PAs.

The project developed the Eco-Egypt concept and campaign as a means to promote conservation and environmentally sustainable practices and operations that are capable of supporting revenue generation and linking with local development. A marine conversation campaign developed and ready to be launched with the return of tourism. An awareness video and posters to be used throughout the Red Sea, hotels, beaches and rooms as well as airplanes, busses setting out main messages for environmental conversation. Private Sector fully involved in nature conversation through the business modeling strategy for the 30 PAs.
